title: Chapter 7050: Don’T Come Over Here

Chapter 7050: Don’T Come Over Here

Chapter 7050: Don’t Come Over Here

“Is he dead?” Ash-serpent wanted to see the result.

The crowd did the same. Once everything dispersed, they saw Li Qiye standing there.

A hole could be seen on his robe, along with a faint scorch mark on his chest. Wisps of blue smoke oozed out.

“No pipe on me, too bad, or I could have lit one up.” Li Qiye patted the smoke away before making a joke.

Everyone became frozen upon seeing the ineffective pulse empowered by the enforcer’s special tribulation. Only a faint burnt mark could be seen on this monstrous body.

If this wasn’t enough to hurt him, what could? Perhaps only true celestial immortals. Therefore, the crowd felt hopeless.

“It’s not a bad toy.” Li Qiye smiled and reached for the weapon.

“Shit!” Immortal Bronze abandoned it instantly.

“Hmm, no need to keep it around.” Li Qiye observed it before crushing the gigantic gun in the blink of an eye.

Ash-serpent and Immortal Bronze thought about escaping. However, the dao court was right there.

“Any other ace card? I’m interested to see them.” Li Qiye said while glancing at Heavencrush.

Everyone became curious if this machine would try to save Immortal Bronze.

“Don’t come over here.” Ash-serpent shuddered with fear. It has been a long time since he last felt fear.

“Do you think it will save you?” Li Qiye smirked while approaching Immortal Bronze.

The latter still retreated.

“Seems like a no. Is there any situation that can make it override the rules and programming?” Li Qiye asked.

“No...” Immortal Bronze answered.

“Interesting, I’ll look into it more, but first, have to finish you two.” Li Qiye said.

Spectators were left speechless after seeing how weak primordial immortals were compared to Li Qiye.

“Violet Sun Immortal, please save me!” Immortal Bronze shouted.

“Oh?” Li Qiye stopped.

“Violet Sun?” Listeners weren’t familiar with this title.

“Violet Sun Golden Immortal.” Heaven’s Equal recognized it and became startled: “Still not dead?”

“Who is that?” Someone asked.

“Zhao Dachui.” An older immortal answered.

“Why does he go by Zhao Dachui then?” Another asked.

“Because his title was cursed, so he abandoned it.” The older immortal responded.

“Cursed by whom?” A supreme overlord asked.

“By Golden Immortal.” The older immortal had a serious expression.

Some believed Zhao Dachui was Violet Sun’s original name at birth. Others said it was just a random nickname chosen by him.

Everyone knew him as Violet Sun beforehand before it was cursed. No one knew the exact details but he stopped using it.

“He must have been Golden Immortal’s disciple.” An old immortal said.

“So a traitor, joining Devouring Alliance.” Someone said.

“He was far from the only one when the alliance was rising.” A golden immortal said.

During Devouring Alliance’s peak, many immortals joined. Some did it out of fear; others wanted to become stronger through devouring.

“Isn’t he dead?” Someone asked.

“Rumble!” Waves surging on the path created by Heavencrush loudly interrupted everyone.
